resolution_summary: All 324 canonical IDs are preserved. The three Civil Service groups were reviewed as legitimate distinct tasks and received context-specific wording, clearer explanations, application-intent labels, and exact source-linked study resources. Q5489 and Q5492 now include approved source sentences to make one answer defensible. The 85 Civil Engineering groups remain intact because their IDs are referenced by eligibility and reuse records; runtime selection suppresses duplicate stems. Five Civil Engineering difficulty conflicts remain review items because difficulty has no psychometric calibration.
